name: application-maintenance-mode-screen
title: Maintenance Mode Screen
description: Full-page scheduled-downtime notice with an ETA, distinct from an error page since it communicates planned maintenance rather than an unexpected failure.
useWhen: Taking the whole app offline for planned maintenance and communicating an expected return time.
Reassuring users that data is safe and no action is needed during a scheduled upgrade.
Offering a live countdown and an email notify-me form so users can find out when service resumes.
avoidWhen: The outage is unexpected, not scheduled — use an error page instead, since 'scheduled maintenance' copy would be misleading.
Only part of a page or feature is affected — use a smaller inline banner or empty state, not a full-page takeover.
No real ETA or countdown target is available — state a vaguer timeframe rather than fabricating a specific time.
responsiveBehavior: The content is centered and constrained to a max width at any viewport size; the countdown row wraps its own content but does not reflow into multiple lines at reasonable widths.
accessibility: The heading uses a real h1 since this is expected to be the only content on the page.
The status icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the heading and body text carry the actual meaning.
The email field in variant 2 has a visually hidden (sr-only) label so screen reader users get an accessible name even though the placeholder is the only visible hint.

variants.title: ETA notice
variants.description: Centered icon, message, and plain-text ETA with a status-page link.
accessibility: The ETA text states an exact time in words, not just an icon or a relative countdown.

variants.title: ETA notice (Dark)
variants.description: ETA maintenance notice adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and badge contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Countdown with notify form
variants.description: Maintenance screen with a live hours/minutes/seconds countdown and an email notify-me form.
accessibility: The countdown numbers are paired with real text labels (hours/minutes/seconds), not color or position alone.

variants.title: Countdown with notify form (Dark)
variants.description: Countdown maintenance screen with a notify form, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Countdown text and form field contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
